items.event_time_ist: Announced Tuesday, Oct 20, 2026 (UK MoD statement; Defence Secretary informed Parliament same day)
items.title: UK to deploy RAF Typhoon fighter jets on defensive missions over Saudi Arabia
items.summary: The United Kingdom announced Tuesday it will deploy Royal Air Force Typhoon fighter jets to fly defensive counter-air missions over Saudi skies, protecting Saudi cities and critical infrastructure from Houthi missiles and drones. Defence Secretary Wes Streeting told Parliament the jets will not conduct offensive strikes inside Yemen or operate in Yemeni airspace. The package also adds UK military advisers and an Atlas A400M transport aircraft, and extends RAF air-to-air refuelling support for Saudi jets by 90 days. First reported by Bloomberg, confirmed by the MoD Tuesday.

items.title: France sends forces to guard Yanbu oil terminal; 100+ US advisers under new joint command
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's plea for allied air-defence help is turning into concrete deployments: France has sent forces to guard the Yanbu oil terminal on the Red Sea coast, and more than 100 American military advisers are working in the kingdom under a newly established joint command, providing intelligence and targeting support, CNN reported Tuesday. Pakistan has personnel stationed in Saudi Arabia under the August mutual-defence pact, and Egypt's parliament is weighing a deployment — marking a further expansion of Western and regional military involvement in the conflict.

items.title: Houthi strike on residential area in besieged Taiz kills two teenage girls — AP
items.summary: Houthi rebels struck a residential area in Yemen's third-largest city, Taiz, on Tuesday, killing two teenage girls, the Associated Press reported. UN human rights chief Volker Turk said the Houthis have largely encircled Taiz, cutting off most supply routes and putting civilians at 'grave risk' as food and necessities run short; the UN warns of a deepening humanitarian crisis in the besieged city.

items.event_time_ist: Tuesday, Oct 21, 2026 (Yemen local time; Houthi claim)
items.title: Houthis claim Saudi airstrikes on two fishing boats off Taiz killed eight
items.summary: The Houthis said Tuesday that Saudi airstrikes on two fishing boats off the coast of Taiz province killed eight people. The claim is unverified, and no coalition response was immediately reported.
